notes.title: THE RETURN OF FLOAT CHAMPIONS
notes.content:
I hope people still play this game. Anyway I plan on making a big update and potentially consistent ones
if the first update receives attention. Here is a basic idea of what I will add in the first update for now
[list]
[*] New maps around 3-5
[*] New skins around 6-12
[*] Gameplay changes mainly around core game loop
[*] Bug fixes even though there aren't any bugs
[*] General improvements including suggestions
[/list]
If you have any thing at all you want to add please, join the discord and let me know. I will do my best to include them I value your opinions. Link to [url=https://discord.gg/QbZkzTkFCC]discord channel[/url].

In the future I can add
[list]
[*] New game modes
[*] More dlc content
[/list]

notes.title: DLC Fix
notes.content:
An issue has been occurring in which the 100 cork pack has not been granting the said in-game items. This issue has been fix(hopefully).
As an apology for the bug, an additional skin has been added to the dlc
This skin being the square skin, turn your bean into a cube
This patch also fixes an issue with the game not updating.
As for the non dlc updates here are the patch notes

Jump cooldown at 0.2 seconds of delay between jumps on ground

New Tournament map added

Fix bug
